name: web_type_focused
description:
web_type_focused:
Type text into the currently-focused textbox (no `ref` required).

Use this when you already clicked into an input and the cursor is there, but you do not have a valid snapshot `ref` for `browser_type`.
It types into `document.activeElement` and can optionally press Enter (`submit: true`).
By default it captures a browser snapshot after typing.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to type into the currently-focused element.

inputs.name: submit
inputs.description: If true, press Enter after typing.

inputs.name: clear_first
inputs.description: If true, clear input/textarea before typing (best-effort).

inputs.name: slowly
inputs.description: If true, type with a small delay between characters.

inputs.name: capture_snapshot
inputs.description: If true, capture browser_snapshot after action and include it in tool result data.

outputs.description: Unique id for the bundled browser_snapshot when captured.

arguments_prompt:
Fill arguments for `web_type_focused`.

Return ONLY a JSON object with:
- text (string, required)
- submit (boolean, default true)
- clear_first (boolean, default true)
- slowly (boolean, default false)
- capture_snapshot (boolean, default true)

Example:
{"text":"cheeseburger","submit":true,"clear_first":true,"capture_snapshot":true}
